question: Simplify: (3x + 2)²
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Directly apply the algebraic identity: (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²

Square of first term (3x) = 9x²

Product of terms × 2 = 2 × 3x × 2 = 12x

Square of second term (2) = 4

Combining all parts: 9x² + 12x + 4

**∴ The correct answer is 9x² + 12x + 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: (3x + 2)²

**Formula Used:**

(a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Comparing (3x + 2)² with (a + b)², we get a = 3x and b = 2.

⇒ Substitute these values into the formula.

⇒ (3x + 2)² = (3x)² + 2 × (3x) × 2 + (2)²

⇒ (3x + 2)² = (3 × 3)x² + (2 × 3 × 2)x + (2 × 2)

⇒ (3x + 2)² = 9x² + 12x + 4

**∴ The correct answer is 9x² + 12x + 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Square of a Difference

(a − b)² = a² − 2ab + b²

Difference of Two Squares

a² − b² = (a − b)(a + b)

Cube of a Sum

(a + b)³ = a³ + b³ + 3ab(a + b)
